rubrics.justification: Morphology is largely consistent with the provided Gardner 3AA data, but no image was available and the response overstates 3AA as the highest category/top-tier when higher expansion stages exist.
Thoroughly integrates age, BMI, ovarian reserve, prior biochemical pregnancies, semen data, endometrium, and cycle history with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logic is clear and probability estimates are reasonably tied to the case factors, though some inferences are speculative and the embryo ranking is slightly overstated.
Mostly evidence-based, but includes several recommendations with limited or controversial guideline support (ERA, routine thrombophilia testing beyond APS, aspirin, endometrial scratching, MTHFR).
Provides concrete next steps for transfer monitoring and future workup/planning, though some suggested interventions are more speculative than standard-of-care.
